The Secretary,

       Scrip Symbol: MARICO 
 
Sub: Audio recording of earnings conference call 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, 
the audio recording of the earnings conference call held today i.e. Monday, November 2, 2026 on the               
un-audited financial results and operations of the Company for the quarter and half year ended        
September 30, 2026, is available on the Company’s website at https://marico.com/india/investors#quarterly. 
 
Further, the transcript of the aforesaid conference call will be intimated to the stock exchanges 
subsequently and published on the Company’s website under the aforesaid link. 
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
 
Thank you. 
 
 
For Marico Limited 
 
 
 
Vinay M A 
Company Secretary & Head- Legal Operations 
 
 
 
VINAY M A
Digitally signed by 
VINAY M A
